dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine:3.23

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG BEETS_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="aptalca"

RUN \
  echo "**** install build packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache --virtual=build-dependencies \
    build-base \
    cairo-dev \
    cargo \
    cmake \
    ffmpeg-dev \
    fftw-dev \
    git \
    gobject-introspection-dev \
    jpeg-dev \
    libedit-dev \
    libpng-dev \
    mpg123-dev \
    openjpeg-dev \
    python3-dev && \
  echo "**** install runtime packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    chromaprint \
    expat \
    ffmpeg \
    fftw \
    flac \
    gdbm \
    gobject-introspection \
    gst-plugins-good \
    gstreamer \
    imagemagick \
    jpeg \
    lame \
    libffi \
    libpng \
    mpg123 \
    mp3gain \
    nano \
    openjpeg \
    python3 \
    sqlite-libs && \
  echo "**** install beets ****" && \
  if [ -z ${BEETS_VERSION+x} ] ; then \
    BEETS_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/beetbox/beets/commits/master" \
    | jq -r .sha); \
  fi && \
  git clone https://github.com/beetbox/beets.git /tmp/beets && \
  cd /tmp/beets && \
  git checkout -f "${BEETS_VERSION}" && \
  echo "**** compile mp3val ****" && \
  mkdir -p \
    /tmp/mp3val-src && \
  curl -o \
  /tmp/mp3val-src/mp3val.tar.gz -sL \
    https://downloads.sourceforge.net/mp3val/mp3val-0.1.8-src.tar.gz && \
  cd /tmp/mp3val-src && \
  tar xzf /tmp/mp3val-src/mp3val.tar.gz --strip 1 && \
  make -f Makefile.linux && \
  cp -p mp3val /usr/bin && \
  echo "**** install pip packages ****" && \
  python3 -m venv /lsiopy && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir \
    pip \
    setuptools && \
  echo "**** install beets ****" && \
  cd /tmp/beets && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.23/ . && \
  echo "**** install pip packages ****" && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.23/ \
    beautifulsoup4 \
    beets-extrafiles \
    beetcamp \
    python3-discogs-client \
    flask \
    flask-cors \
    PyGObject \
    pyacoustid \
    pylast \
    requests \
    requests_oauthlib \
    typing-extensions \
    unidecode && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apk del --purge \
    build-dependencies && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    $HOME/.cache \
    $HOME/.cargo

# environment settings
ENV BEETSDIR="/config" \
EDITOR="nano" \
HOME="/config"

# copy local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 8337
VOLUME /config

units.name: init-beets-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# copy config
cp -n /defaults/beets.sh /config/beets.sh
cp -n /defaults/config.yaml /config/config.yaml

chmod +x /config/beets.sh

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    # permissions
    lsiown -R abc:abc \
        /config
fi

units.name: svc-beets
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 8337" \
            s6-setuidgid abc beet web
else
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 8337" \
            beet web
fi

notes.upstream:
Update dependencies to fix vulnerabilities (#7146)

## Update locked dependencies to fix Dependabot alerts 🔒

This refreshes `uv.lock` to pick up patched versions for the open
[Dependabot security
alerts](https://github.com/beetbox/beets/security/dependabot). Only the
lockfile changes. `pyproject.toml` is untouched, so the declared version
ranges stay the same.

## Key Changes

### 1. Security fixes 🛡️

- **Change:** locked dependencies bumped to versions that clear the open
Dependabot alerts.
- **Purpose:** close the alerts on the default branch.

### 2. Notable version bumps ⬆️

Major bumps that are worth a closer look in CI:

| Package | Old | New |
|---|---|---|
| `pillow` | `12.3.0` | `13.0.0` |
| `python-dateutil` | `2.9.0.post0` | `4.0.0` |
| `sphinxcontrib-jsmath` | `1.0.1` | `2.0.0` |
| `soco` | `0.31.5` | `0.32.1` |

Minor and patch bumps:
- **Runtime/plugins:** `certifi`, `confuse`, `filelock`,
`httpcore2`/`httpx2` (`2.13.1` -> `2.16.0`), `msgpack`, `numba`, `numpy`
(`2.5.3` -> `2.5.4`), `oauthlib`, `platformdirs`, `py7zr`, `pycparser`,
`pycryptodomex`, `pyrate-limiter`, `texttable`, `truststore`, `tzdata`,
`brotli`/`brotlicffi`, `backports-zstd`, `anyio`, `dbus-python`, all
`gstreamer-*` packages (`1.28.7` -> `1.28.8`)
- **Dev/tooling:** `pytest` (`9.1.1` -> `9.2.0`), `pluggy`, `coverage`,
`mypy`, `ruff` (`0.17.0` -> `0.17.3`), `faker`, `setuptools`,
`narwhals`, `ast-serialize`, `domdf-python-tools`, `types-pyyaml`,
`types-requests`

### 3. Lockfile resolution changes 🔀

- **Change:** the lockfile `revision` goes from `3` to `5`. The resolver
now also splits markers at `python_full_version < '3.11.5'`. That forks
the resolution for some packages: new `soupsieve` `3.0.4` for newer
interpreters, and separate `beautifulsoup4`, `numpy` and `scipy`
entries.
- **Change:** new `gstreamer-bundle`, `gstreamer-plugins*` and
`gstreamer-plugins-libs` entries at `1.28.8`. `tomli` is no longer
locked.
- **Impact:** contributors need a recent `uv` that understands lockfile
revision `5`.

## Notes 📝

- **Older `uv`:** contributors on an older `uv` may fail to read the
lockfile and will need to upgrade.
